title: workflint JSON output, version 1
description: What `workflint -format json` prints. Each line of `-format jsonl` is a `line`, defined below. docs/json-output.md describes the fields and the versioning rules. Consumers must ignore keys they do not know, because a later workflint may add keys without changing the version.

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic of the run, in the order of the default output: the files in the order of the arguments, or of their paths in a run without arguments, and the diagnostics of each file by position.

version.description: The version of this schema. It changes only when a key is removed, renamed, or changes its meaning.

line.description: One line of `-format jsonl`: a diagnostic with the version of the schema.

rule.description: The workflint rule ID, such as `undefined-property`.

kind.description: The actionlint kind of the rule, such as `expression`.

message.description: The message, as the default output prints it.

help.description: A hint on how to fix the problem, or null.

path.description: The path of the file, as the default output prints it, or the name of the workflow read from stdin.

start.description: The position of the first byte of the span.

end.description: The position just after the last byte of the span. It equals `start` for an empty span.

column.description: The 1-based column, counted in Unicode code points.

offset.description: The 0-based offset in bytes from the start of the file.
